Hi micka1,

there is no expectation here that someone will come and cure me! lol

Hearing other stories puts things in perspective. I have as well experience with losing quite some weight so patience and discipline is key. Need to be more conscious about patience and discipline in day to day life.

Best, Art

micka1 wrote: @Art...

I went from 50 to 10/15 trades (sometimes 20 trades per month, it depends..) Just by being very (extremely) picky with my trades. So i end up avoiding many "potential" trades. (in other words, trades that look good but not picture perfect). And like i also said, "patience" is key. And when i say patience, i mean not touching a trade even if it goes against you after being in profit. Not reducing the lot size. (no partial closing, no trailing stops). Personally speaking i rarely use any targets. (take profits). I sometimes manually move my stop loss, but only if the market sturcture allows it and if price is already distant from my entry. My trades usually last several hours, sometimes days...

Stylistically, i don't have a lot of new things to bring to this forum (but it's always interesting to see how others view the market). I don't trade that much differently than most of you guys. I use a lot of confluences for my trades (even though i could trade them fully "naked" on the chart). I use channels, Pivot points, SD, wait for traps. And occasionally use fibs.Most importantly, i only enter a position if the entry is ridiculously obvious. (That's another way to avoid over-trading).

So patience and discipline are very important. There should be no difference between forextester & a live chart. If you're still struggling on a live chart, (and again, if it's mostly a psychological problem), then change your bad habits. Do a checklist. We often lie to ourselves. People have a hard time admitting it, but it's part of human nature.

I don't know how to help you, i can only talk about my personal experience. What helped me (with my discipline, patience, sticking to my goals, having the mental strength)...Was not trading but losing weight and getting in shape. Losing my belly fat was a real nightmare....But i was determined to do it. Americans, Europeans etc.. Spend billions a year on weight-loss programs. Why? Because 90% of people don't have the discipline or patience to stick to their goals/gameplans. They always end up lying to themselves. You'll see the same problem with trading....Trading is just a different facet of the same thing...Smokers have the same problem..Alcoholics, drug addicts etc....All have a hard time with their bad habits. Once you've fixed this mental problem, then your live trades will mirror your demo/forextester results. The bad news..... It can take weeks, months, years...Before it happens.

PS: and yes, i have six pack abs now. lol
